第1章(1)
「小姐、小姐，等等我呀，族长吩咐过别乱跑的！」
一片开满粉色荷花的湖面上，横架着一座九曲桥，一名十几岁的小丫鬟正追着另一名才八岁的小小姐，小小姐银铃般清脆的笑声回荡在荷花湖面上，奔跑的脚步始终没停下，压根儿不管小丫鬟的叮咛。
「朵儿，这里好漂亮，有好多漂亮的园子，还有好多漂亮的屋舍，跟咱们住的地方完全都不一样。」宗雪莹初次出远门，她看什么都觉得好有趣，心情始终兴奋开心，静都静不下来。
放眼望去，雕工精致的亭台楼阁，景观美丽的花桥水榭，处处都是经过精心打造的美景，走在任何一处，都像是在仙境一样，让她一双眼睁得好大，不想错过任何一丁点景物。
「小姐，这里可是兰凌王宫，不是咱们隐族村落，小心乱跑会闯祸的！」朵儿无奈地说，继续追着宗雪莹跑，对小姐的活泼好动有些吃不消。
他们来到的地方是「兰凌国」，处于中土之东，物产丰饶，民强兵勇，百姓们安居乐业，王族以兰为姓，代代世袭，长久以来不曾断绝过。
而他们是「隐族」的族人，跟着族长从「云渺山」过来，初到兰凌王宫，族长正在大殿里和太后谈话，没想到小姐就耐不住性子要求先出来逛逛，朵儿只好亦步亦趋地跟着，免得小姐跑得不见踪影。
宗雪莹当没听到朵儿的唠叨，开心地越过九曲桥，闯进一处被茂林环绕的小偏殿，偏殿的梁柱都用暗红色漆为底，佐以金色线条，绘制出繁复的图样，看起来华丽又大器，教她看傻了眼。
「哇……真是漂亮……」这些柱子会不会一摸就被她给碰坏了呀？她想摸，又怕碰坏，只能眼巴巴地望着。
隐约之间，她似乎听到有人在偏殿深处咳嗽的声音，一时好奇，她便迈开步伐走进去，想知道有谁在里面。
「咳……咳咳……」
「王，要不要披一件披风？奴婢……」
「滚开！本王没这么不济事！」
宗雪莹走过回廊，转一个弯，来到偏殿旁的一座小湖泊边，湖岸旁有一个小小的观景亭，声音就是从亭里传出来的。
一名十多岁的少年正站在亭里，脸色苍白，病恹恹的，一旁宫女怀里抱着一件薄披风，想要帮他披上，却被他狠狠地甩开，不让她靠近。
「王……」宫女真的很担心，他强撑着病体出来透气，只会让身子更糟。
「本王叫你滚，你是听不懂吗？」年仅十五的兰霆憎恶地怒斥，一时情绪太过激动，又忍不住呛咳出声，脸色更是惨白了。「唔咳咳咳……」
长年卧病在床，什么事情都不得意，让他的脾气暴烈，遇到身子状况糟，全身都难过的时候，他更是无法控制自己的脾气。
他真恨自己这个病弱的身子，从一出生就没一日好过，总是大病小病不断，连活不活得到成年都是个问题。

一到寒冷的冬天，他只能躺在烧起无数个暖炉的屋里，寸步都离不开房，没想到就算现在早已入夏，他连出来透个气也不行，身子依旧虚弱，只走一小段路而已，他就已经感到气喘吁吁。
他恨这一副躯体，更恨别人对他的怜悯、照顾，这让他觉得自己是个一无是处的废物，勉强活着也是浪费！
宗雪莹看着眼前病弱的大哥哥，马上猜出他的身分，便大胆地进到亭子里，兴奋地指着他嚷道：「我知道了，你就是娘所说的新王兰霆吧？」
前任兰王一年前在狩猎时出了意外，重伤而逝，前任兰王只有一名继承子嗣兰霆，却总是被病魔所扰，所以他们此次来到兰凌王宫，是要报答隐族欠下的恩情，来帮助病弱的新王兰霆。
不过他的脾气有些吓人呢，幸好她胆子够大，不怕不怕。
「你是谁？」兰霆强撑着精神瞪她，对她的无礼感到极度不悦。「竟敢直呼本王的名讳，你到底懂不懂礼数？」
「不能唤你的名吗？」她一脸无辜的搔搔头，娇声咕哝着。「宫里的人真奇怪，礼节一大堆，什么事情都不能做，倒不如在咱们自家村里过得快活。」
她之前在隐族村落时就是个野丫头，现在才刚到这里，什么规矩都不懂，也难怪敢当着王的面抱怨出声。
兰霆怒瞪着她，她的脸蛋圆润，双眼灿亮，小小的嘴唇微翘，是个非常健康且讨喜的小女娃，而她的健康，就像是在嘲笑他的病弱，她灿烂的笑容更让他感到厌恶，对他来说，简直是个碍眼的存在。
「快滚！」兰霆恼火地挥袖斥退她。「别让本王再见到你！」
「啊——」个头小小的宗雪莹被他不小心地挥中，脚步踉跄地一屁股往后跌坐在地上。
兰霆错愕地一愣，他只是想赶她走，并不是有心想推倒她的，但错已造成，他也拉不下脸认错，表情更是难看。
「小姐！」随后才追来的朵儿，一过来就见到自家小姐跌坐在地，担心地急忙冲过来。「没事吧小姐，有没有摔伤了？」
「没事没事。」不用朵儿搀扶，宗雪莹倒是自己站了起来，拍拍屁股上的灰尘，依旧笑得灿烂。「我一点事也没有，王不用太在意。」
反正她也常跑跑跳跳的跌跤，这对她来说就像在吃饭喝水般的平常，就算真会痛，一下子也就退去了，不碍事。
兰霆的双眉紧蹙，非常不满意她的反应，被他推了一把，她为什么还笑得出来？她应该要委屈地哭出来，不是吗？
她越不在乎，他反倒越是介意，一把莫名的火气袭上心头，气她的太过豁达，让他觉得自己像是个恶劣的混蛋！
「谁说本王在意？本王根本不把你看在眼里！」他负气地离开亭子，管不了自己虚弱的身子，根本禁不起疾走，只因不想再见到她太过碍眼的笑容。
「王，等等奴婢！」宫女赶紧追出亭子，就怕他走太快，身子会负荷不了。
果不其然，兰霆才走没多远，头顶上热辣的阳光就让他头晕目眩，他的身体左摇右晃，越来越昏眩，几乎要站不住脚。

「真是……该死……」他抚着昏沈的额头，感到很懊恼、非常不甘心。
「啊——王——」
他身体无力的一软，在他倒下的那一刻，他看到宫女惊慌地向他跑过来，也见到那个圆润的小丫头一脸担心的模样，好像他是她什么重要的人似的。
为什么关心他？他们俩根本素不相识。在失去意识之前，他的脑海里只有这个想法，很困惑……很不习惯……
他不需要任何人的怜悯，就算真的病死了，也不需要……
在昏沈之间，兰霆只觉得身子很热、很难受，耳旁断断续续传来有人交谈的声音，但到底说了些什么，他根本就听不清楚。
他感到前所未有的难受，好像身体里有着什么不知名的东西一直胀大、胀大，就快撑破他的身子，让他几乎无法呼吸。
难道他将要死了？也罢，这一副破身子，勉强活着也只是麻烦，倒不如早早结束，反正他也不在乎了……
但就在他出现绝望念头时，身体的胀痛却像是找到一个出口，慢慢泄了出去，终于不再那样难受。
发生什么事了？他感到原本被病魔纠缠住的沉重身子，有种逐渐轻盈的感觉，就连呼吸也顺畅不少。
疲累地睁开双眼，他看到自己躺在寝殿里，不知道已经昏睡多久，全身又酸又软，连半点力气也没有。

Chapter 1(1)
"Miss, miss, wait for me, the patriarch told me not to run around!"
一片开满粉色荷花的湖面上，横架着一座九曲桥，一名十几岁的小丫鬟正追着另一名才八岁的小小姐，小小姐银铃般清脆的笑声回荡在荷花湖面上，奔跑的脚步始终没停下，压根儿不管小丫鬟的叮咛。
「朵儿，这里好漂亮，有好多漂亮的园子，还有好多漂亮的屋舍，跟咱们住的地方完全都不一样。」宗雪莹初次出远门，她看什么都觉得好有趣，心情始终兴奋开心，静都静不下来。
Looking around, she could see the exquisitely carved pavilions and pavilions, the beautiful flower bridges and pavilions, and the carefully crafted beauty everywhere. Everywhere she walked, it felt like she was in a fairyland. She opened her eyes wide and didn't want to miss any of the scenery.
"Miss, this is the Lanling Palace, not our hermit village. Be careful if you run around and you may get into trouble!" Duo'er said helplessly and continued to chase Zong Xueying, feeling a little overwhelmed by the young lady's liveliness.
他们来到的地方是「兰凌国」，处于中土之东，物产丰饶，民强兵勇，百姓们安居乐业，王族以兰为姓，代代世袭，长久以来不曾断绝过。
And they were members of the "Hidden Clan". They came from "Yunmiao Mountain" with the clan leader. When they first arrived at Lanling Palace, the clan leader was talking to the Queen Mother in the main hall. Unexpectedly, the young lady lost her temper and asked to go out for a walk first. Duo'er had to follow step by step to prevent the young lady from running away and disappearing.
宗雪莹当没听到朵儿的唠叨，开心地越过九曲桥，闯进一处被茂林环绕的小偏殿，偏殿的梁柱都用暗红色漆为底，佐以金色线条，绘制出繁复的图样，看起来华丽又大器，教她看傻了眼。
"Wow...it's so beautiful..." Will these pillars be broken by her as soon as she touches them? She wanted to touch it, but was afraid of damaging it, so she could only look at it eagerly.
Vaguely, she seemed to hear the sound of someone coughing deep in the side hall. Curious, she walked in to find out who was inside.
"Cough...cough..."
"King, do you want to wear a cloak? My slave..."
"Go away! I am not that helpless!"
宗雪莹走过回廊，转一个弯，来到偏殿旁的一座小湖泊边，湖岸旁有一个小小的观景亭，声音就是从亭里传出来的。
一名十多岁的少年正站在亭里，脸色苍白，病恹恹的，一旁宫女怀里抱着一件薄披风，想要帮他披上，却被他狠狠地甩开，不让她靠近。
"King..." The palace maid was really worried. He forced his sick body to come out for air, which would only make his body worse.
「本王叫你滚，你是听不懂吗？」年仅十五的兰霆憎恶地怒斥，一时情绪太过激动，又忍不住呛咳出声，脸色更是惨白了。 "Ahem, cough, cough..."
长年卧病在床，什么事情都不得意，让他的脾气暴烈，遇到身子状况糟，全身都难过的时候，他更是无法控制自己的脾气。
He really hated his sickly body. He had never had a good day since he was born. He was always suffering from major and minor illnesses. Even whether he would survive to adulthood was a problem.
一到寒冷的冬天，他只能躺在烧起无数个暖炉的屋里，寸步都离不开房，没想到就算现在早已入夏，他连出来透个气也不行，身子依旧虚弱，只走一小段路而已，他就已经感到气喘吁吁。
He hated this body, and even more, he hated the pity and care others showed him. This made him feel that he was a worthless waste and that barely living was a waste!
Zong Xueying looked at the sickly elder brother in front of her and immediately guessed his identity. She boldly entered the pavilion, pointed at him excitedly and shouted: "I understand, you are the new Wang Lanting that mother mentioned, right? "
The previous King Lan had an accident while hunting a year ago and died of serious injuries. The previous King Lan only had one heir, Lan Ting, but he was always troubled by illness. Therefore, they came to the Lanling Palace this time to repay the kindness owed by the hermit clan and to help the new king Lan Ting, who was sick.
But his temper was a little scary. Fortunately, she was brave enough and wasn't afraid.
"Who are you?" Lan Ting forced himself to glare at her, feeling extremely displeased with her rudeness. "You dare to call me by my first name. Do you know etiquette?"
"Can't I call you by your name?" She scratched her head innocently and cooed. "The people in the palace are so strange. They have a lot of etiquette and can't do anything. It would be better to live happily in our own village."
She had been a wild girl in the Yin Clan village before, but now she had just arrived here and didn't understand any rules. No wonder she dared to complain in front of the king.
Lan Ting glared at her. She had a round face, bright eyes, and slightly curled lips. She was a very healthy and lovable little girl. Her health seemed to be mocking his weakness. Her bright smile disgusted him even more. To him, she was simply an eyesore.
"Get out!" Lan Ting waved his sleeves angrily to repel her. "Don't let me see you again!"
"Ah——" The small Zong Xueying was accidentally hit by him, staggering and fell back to the ground.
Lan Ting was stunned for a moment. He just wanted to drive her away, not push her down, but the mistake had been made, and he couldn't help but admit his mistake, and his expression was even more ugly.
"Miss!" Duo'er, who was chasing after her, saw her young lady lying on the ground as soon as she came over. She rushed over worriedly. "Are you okay, miss? Did you get hurt from the fall?"
"It's okay, it's okay." Zong Xueying stood up on her own without Duo'er's support, patted the dust on her butt, and still smiled brightly. "There's nothing wrong with me, so the king doesn't need to worry too much."
Anyway, she often runs, jumps and falls, which is as normal to her as eating and drinking. Even if it does hurt, it will subside immediately and it will not be a problem.
Lan Ting frowned, very dissatisfied with her reaction. Why could she still laugh after he pushed her? She should cry out of grievance, right?
The more she didn't care, the more he cared. An inexplicable anger came over him, angry that she was too open-minded and made him feel like a bad bastard!
"Who said I care? I don't care about you at all!" He left the pavilion angrily. He couldn't care about his weak body and couldn't bear to walk quickly, just because he didn't want to see her smile that was too eye-catching again.
"King, wait a minute, slave!" The palace maid hurriedly chased him out of the pavilion, fearing that his body would not be able to bear the load if he walked too fast.
Sure enough, Lan Ting hadn't gone very far when the hot sunshine above his head made him dizzy. His body swayed left and right, becoming more and more dizzy, and he could hardly stand.
"It's really... damn..." He stroked his sleepy forehead, feeling very annoyed and unwilling.
"Ah——King——"
His body went limp. The moment he fell, he saw the palace maid running toward him in panic, and also saw the chubby little girl with a worried look on her face, as if he was someone important to her.
Why care about him? They didn't know each other at all. Before he lost consciousness, he only had this thought in his mind. He was very confused...and not used to it...
He doesn't need anyone's pity, even if he really dies of illness, he doesn't need it...
In his daze, Lan Ting felt that his body was very hot and uncomfortable, and the sound of someone talking could be heard intermittently in his ears, but he couldn't hear clearly what was said.
He felt more uncomfortable than ever before, as if there was something unknown in his body that was swelling and swelling, and was about to burst his body, leaving him almost helpless.Dharma breathing.
Is he going to die? No matter, with this broken body, barely surviving is just a trouble, it's better to end it as soon as possible, he doesn't care anyway...
But just when he had desperate thoughts, the swelling and pain in his body seemed to find an outlet and slowly leaked out, and finally it was no longer so uncomfortable.
What happened? He felt that his heavy body, which was originally entangled with the disease, gradually became lighter, and even his breathing became much smoother.
He opened his eyes tiredly and saw that he was lying in the bedroom. He had been sleeping for an unknown period of time. His whole body was sore and weak, and he didn't even have the slightest strength.
